notes.title: v1.1.1 Patch
notes.content: [p]Just a minor patch, folks. Like changin' the bobber, not the bait.[/p][list][*][p]Updated Humpback Whitefish spawns to reliably spawn S and M sizes[/p][/*][*][p]Added camera toggle button for gamepad (L3) and keyboard (C)[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary fish will spawn again after a day (20hrs real time)[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the chance larger fish will eat the fish on your hook[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "catch fish with a fish" completing when it shouldn't[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed edge case where "catch fish above water" achievements wouldn't complete[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Autumnwood Lake Now Open + DLC Sneak peek!
notes.content:
[p]Howdy folks![/p][p]If yer itchin’ for a fresh cast and some crisp fall air, Autumnwood Lake is now ready for visitin’! Just swing by [b]Rusty’s Bait n’ Tackle[/b] to grab yerself the [b]Autumnwood Fishing License[/b], and you’ll unlock a whole mess o’ goodies.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6j3MxdBuc7U;full"][/previewyoutube][h1]🍁Autumnwood Lake Update includes:[/h1][p][/p][h3]2 BEAUTIFUL NEW FISHIN’ SPOTS[/h3][p][b]• Shallows Edge[/b] – A peaceful stretch o' shoreline where the water’s shallow, leaves float lazy-like, and ya might spot an owl watchin’ from the trees. Snow-capped mountains stand guard in the distance, lookin’ like a postcard come to life.[/p][p][b]• Otter Cove[/b] – Tucked away and full o’ charm, this cozy lil’ cove’s got smooth rocks, driftwood galore, and a gentle waterfall tricklin’ down into a pool where, get this, a whole family o’ otters has moved in! [/p][p][/p][h3]WHAT ELSE IS NEW?[/h3][list][*][p][b]8 New Fish Species[/b] to discover
(Yup, [b]2 more legendary lunkers[/b] in the mix - good luck landin’ those beauties!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]A Dachshund Companion[/b] option (That’s right, a lil’ sausage dog in the boat with ya - cuter than a bug’s ear.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 New Lures to Unlock:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Heavy Drop Shot[/p][/*][*][p]Minnow Swimbait[/p][/*][*][p]Bluegill Swimbait[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Rod: The Copperleaf 86[/b] Made for L to XXL fish, and spooled with a fluoro line that’s strong but sneaky. Won’t spook them bigger picky ones![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]EXTRA GOODIES:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Gamepad Vibration Support[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]More Performance Improvements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Some fish now eat smaller fish[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]EASTERN WINDS DLC ANNOUNCEMENT[/h2][p]Hold onto yer tackle box - we just dropped the [b]first teaser image[/b] for the upcoming DLC: [b]Eastern Winds[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/ef5da96a0da69e61eb024d2ee6f680a269bc9385.png"][/img][/p][p]This one's shapin' up to be a real beaut. Picture this: cherry blossoms dancin’ on the breeze, bamboo rustlin’ by still shores, and ancient shrines overlookin’ misty coves full of fish so strange you’ll think you’re dreamin’. [/p][p][/p][p]Whether you’re castin’ from a lily-covered riverbank or driftin’ through foggy mountain lakes, there’s always somethin’ rare on the line. [/p][p][/p][p]👉 Wishlist Eastern Winds now and be ready for a whole new chapter in yer anglin’ adventures![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4001650/Cast_n_Chill__Eastern_Winds/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Keep yer lines tight and yer thermos full - we’ve got [b]more free updates comin’[/b] over the next few months.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v1.0.2 Fish Fighting Update
notes.content:
[p]Howdy folks, and thanks for playing! Since launch, we’ve been reading your feedback and working hard on an update focused on refining the fish fighting mechanics and adding some fun new features.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎣 Fish Fighting Improvements[/b][/h3][p]You can now let your line go slack and see it with clear visual cues to help you manage tension and avoid over-pulling. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/b2f6ba4d4f79b2cf50a96b763839a30093467388.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’ve also added the ability to steer and guide the fish slightly when pulling at just the right time and improved bubble particles to let you know when the fish is thrashing easier.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐟 Smarter Fish Behaviour[/b][/h3][p] Fish no longer sprint endlessly in one direction or head butt the lakebed. Their movement is now more natural and satisfying.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧍 New Angler Animations[/b][/h3][p]
We’ve added some lovely new animations to bring your angler to life with more personality.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/2286b847e880c04b86c485fbe55f915bd94618d2.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]⚙️ Idle Mode Enhancements[/b][/h3][p]
You can now tweak Idle Mode to limit what can be caught passively.
And introducing [b]Screensaver Mode[/b] – no progression, no sales, no achievements. Just relax and enjoy the scenery.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐶 New Pupper Option[/b][/h3][p]
There’s a new good doggo to choose from: a loyal German Shepherd companion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/e5b4749c1ed18667c6e288e320140d833056549d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you to everyone who helped Beta test this update! [/h3]

notes.title: DREDGE x Cast n Chill Bundle Now Available
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/a01bf79124ce3f80cb26fffd200ace6a86a70b2d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’re beyond excited to launch the [b]DREDGE x Cast n Chill Bundle[/b] – a perfect pairing of two very different (but equally awesome) fishing games, now available together at [b]10% off[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]DREDGE[/b] is a critically acclaimed single-player fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. It’s atmospheric, beautifully crafted, and packed with mystery. From its haunting soundtrack to its tight gameplay loop, it’s no surprise DREDGE has hooked players and critics alike. We're genuinely honoured to bundle our cozy little fishing game alongside something this good.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Cast n Chill[/b], on the other hand, is all about laid-back vibes. Explore serene waters, reel in rare catches, upgrade your gear, and enjoy the journey with your trusty pup by your side. Whether you play actively or let it idle, it’s all about relaxing at your own pace.[/p][p][/p][p]This bundle brings together the dark and the dreamy – and you can get both for [b]10% off[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]🎣 Cast your line into both worlds today![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55945/DREDGE_x_Cast_n_Chill/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Cast n Chill Demo v2 is Live
notes.content:
Hey there folks,

A big thank you to everyone who filled out our feedback form or dropped suggestions in the Steam forums, your thoughts have been incredibly helpful in shaping this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/f9167243fbc2d39251b258a532277f94940e909b.png[/img]

We’ve just released a new version of the Cast n Chill demo packed with features you asked for. Whether it was improving fishing mechanics, adding new content, or making the game even more relaxing to play, we’ve listened, and here’s what’s new:

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*]  [b]Fawnmirror Lake[/b] – A tranquil new location to explore, unlocked via fishing license
[*]  [b]5 New Fish, 1 New Rod, 5 New Lures[/b] – Expand your gear and discover new species to catch
[*]  [b]Idle Mode[/b] – Let the game cast for you while you chill and enjoy a calming, passive experience
[*]  [b]Vertical Mode[/b] – Resize the window to sit neatly on the side of your screen
[*]  [b]Zoom Out Option[/b] – Get a taller view of the stunning landscapes and soak in more scenery
[*]  [b]Refined Fishing Mechanics[/b] – Improved line controls and a new lure system linking lures to rods
[*]  [b]Fish Battle Balancing[/b] – Reeling in fish now feels more responsive and rewarding (the fish get tired!)
[*]  [b]Nibbles[/b] – Fish may nibble without biting, use the right lure to hook the species you’re after
[*]  [b]Fish Discovery & Logbook[/b] – Find new fish to unlock their details in your logbook and research the best lure to use
[*]  [b]Character Customiser [/b]– Shuffle your look with a randomiser (full customisation coming soon)
[*]  [b]New Music & Soundscapes[/b] – Tranquil new music and improved natural soundscapes to deepen your relaxation
[/list]

This update is a big step toward the cozy fishing experience we’ve all been imagining, and it wouldn’t be possible without your feedback. If you get a chance to try the demo again, we’d love to hear what you think!

Thanks for being part of the journey,
 - Team Wombat Brawler

[url=http://mailinglist.castnchill.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470446/84a1b37020cb62e1cf03c3f9045afeac4b672353.png[/img][/url]
